summary: Completed end-to-end testing of Forge Athletics marketing site. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed against external URL covering root, consultation CRUD/validation, and newsletter (success/duplicate/invalid). Frontend: Hero, sticky nav (6 links + CTA), smooth scroll, mobile hamburger menu (open/close), 4 service cards, 3 pricing tiers with Performance Most Popular badge, animated counters (10+/500+/37), all 4 social icons, contact form validation (empty -> 'Select a goal' error) and successful POST -> /api/consultation 200 + success toast, newsletter footer POST -> /api/newsletter 200 + success toast, duplicate -> 409 + 'Already subscribed' info toast all verified.
action_items: Minor naming mismatch (non-blocking): the 'Programs' nav link uses data-testid='nav-link-services' (id 'services') instead of 'nav-link-programs' as listed in the request. Functionality is correct; consider aligning the id/data-testid with the visible label if external test scripts target 'programs'.

Code review: server.py defines `logger` (line 137) AFTER it is referenced inside create_consultation (line 98). It works at runtime because the function is invoked after module load, but it's fragile - move `logging.basicConfig`/`logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` above the route definitions for clarity and to avoid future static-analysis warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is used before its module-level definition (used at L98, defined at L137). Functional but bad practice - reorder.
server.py: uses deprecated FastAPI on_event('shutdown') handler - consider lifespan handler.
Nav.jsx: link id 'services' is labelled 'Programs' which causes a small testid contract mismatch with the task spec ('nav-link-programs').
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created test consultation + newsletter records with TEST_ / test_ prefixes via API during tests; no cleanup performed (data is leads, retained intentionally).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend external URL = https://coach-elite-training.preview.emergentagent.com (frontend/.env). Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` for regression. Form-goal is a NATIVE <select>, not Radix - use `select_option(value=...)`. Mode is two buttons with data-testid form-mode-in-person / form-mode-online. Contact form errors appear inline (text under field), not toasts; success/duplicate/error states for newsletter use sonner toasts. Mobile hamburger uses data-testid nav-mobile-toggle / nav-mobile-menu / nav-mobile-link-{id}.
